## Why

Describe the problem and who it affects.

## Changes

Describe the resulting behavior or documentation change. For visible application copy, quote it and explain why it is needed.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Separate local, CI, simulated, and real-provider evidence. Explain omitted checks and any known failures. For application UI changes, include the relevant CI screenshot.

## Related issue

Link an issue when one exists. Keep credentials, personal data, production data, and private machine details out of the PR and its attachments.
